name: v0.9.2
body:
## Try it without installing (Linux)

The new **AppImage** runs Muninn from a single file — no package, no install receipt:

```sh
curl -fsSLO https://github.com/raythurman2386/muninn/releases/latest/download/muninn_v0.9.2_linux_x86_64.AppImage
chmod +x muninn_v0.9.2_linux_x86_64.AppImage
./muninn_v0.9.2_linux_x86_64.AppImage
```

Use `muninn_v0.9.2_linux_aarch64.AppImage` on ARM64. If FUSE is unavailable, add `--appimage-extract-and-run`. The AppImage is covered by `checksums.txt` and the GitHub attestations like every other asset. It is built on Ubuntu 24.04 (glibc 2.39) and has no auto-update: download the next release to upgrade.

## Reliability

`wgpu` 30.0.2 brings upstream fixes for a texture-ID leak when surface acquisition returns no texture, a mapped-buffer use-after-free on device loss, and Metal wide-gamut/sRGB color handling. `zeroize` and `uuid` are patch updates.

## Assets

Eleven files: Linux x86_64/aarch64 tarballs and AppImages, macOS aarch64 tarball, Windows x86_64 zip, both `.deb`s, `install.sh`, `checksums.txt` and the Sigstore bundle.

## What's Changed
* chore: refresh AUR and site snapshot for 0.9.1 by @raythurman2386 in https://github.com/raythurman2386/muninn/pull/256
* packaging: add Linux AppImage assets (#258) by @raythurman2386 in https://github.com/raythurman2386/muninn/pull/259
* chore(deps): bump the cargo group with 3 updates by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/raythurman2386/muninn/pull/257
* Release 0.9.2: Linux AppImage assets and dependency updates by @raythurman2386 in https://github.com/raythurman2386/muninn/pull/260
